question: The Draft Greenhouse Gases Emissions Intensity (GEI) Target Rules, 2025, was notified by which Ministry of India in April 2025?

options.text: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)** is responsible for the planning, promotion, and coordination of environmental and forestry-related policies in India.
 
• In April 2025, the Ministry notified the **Draft Greenhouse Gases Emissions Intensity (GEI) Target Rules, 2025**, aiming to regulate and set targets for reducing greenhouse gas emissions in line with India's commitments under global climate agreements.
